form.invalidEmail: Enter an e-mail address like name@example.com.
form.passwordHint: At least {{count}} characters. A few words in a row work well.
form.name: Your name

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.noAccount: No account? Ask the admin of this Dive Hub for an invitation.
signIn.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
signIn.disabled: This account is disabled. Ask an admin.
signIn.about: Dive Hub keeps the dive logs of a club, a family or a dive center in one place.

setup.title: Set up Dive Hub
setup.intro: Create the first admin account. The setup token is in the server log (for example docker compose logs app).

invitation.title: Join Dive Hub
invitation.intro: You were invited as {{email}}. Choose your name and a password.
invitation.askForNewLink: Ask the admin for a new link.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.intro: Choose a new password for {{email}}. You’ll be signed out everywhere else.

account.title: My account
account.changed: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
account.signOutOthersBody: Every other browser and device where you’re signed in has to sign in again.
account.signOutThisBody: You’ll need your password to sign in again.

admin.linkIntro: Send this link to {{to}}. It works once, until {{until}}, and is shown only now.
admin.name: Name
admin.deleteBody: This removes their account, their uploaded files and Imports, and their own Diver with all Dives. It can’t be undone. To keep the data, disable the User instead.
admin.demoteSelfBody: You’ll lose access to this page. Another admin can give the role back.
admin.revokeBody: The link stops working. You can invite them again with a new link.
admin.disableBody: They can’t sign in anymore and are signed out everywhere. Their data stays, and you can enable them again.
admin.signOutBody: All their sessions end. They can sign in again.

import.title: Import
import.drop: Drop Garmin FIT files or zips here
import.hint: “Export Original” zips from Garmin Connect and files copied from the watch both work.

reason.not_your_diver: recorded for a Diver you don’t manage
reason.max_depth_differs: the max depth differs too much

errorCode.unsupported_file: This is neither a FIT file nor a zip archive.

import.skipped: Skipped {{names}}: only FIT files and zip archives can be imported.
import.dropAnywhere: You can also drop FIT files and zips anywhere on this page.
import.findConnect: Garmin Connect website: open a dive, choose “Export Original” in the gear menu, and import the zip as it is.
import.findWatch: Watch: connect it by USB and copy the files from the folder GARMIN/Activity.

logbook.title: Logbook
logbook.empty: No dives yet. Import your files above to fill the logbook.
logbook.searchHint: A dive number, or words from the notes

dive.title: Dive {{number}}
dive.profileFailed: The depth profile couldn’t be drawn.
dive.willReset: Goes back to {{value}} when you save
dive.changedMeanwhile: This dive was changed meanwhile. Reload it and make your changes again.
dive.primaryHint: The dive’s values come from the primary recording, unless you set them by hand.
dive.moveIntro: The dive, its recordings and notes go to the other Diver’s logbook.
dive.splitOff: Split off into its own dive
dive.splitOffBody: It becomes a dive of its own, with its own history. This dive keeps its other recordings.
dive.unsavedQuestion: Leave without saving? Your changes to this dive will be lost.
dive.splitOffMenu: Split off into its own dive…
dive.primaryChanged: This is now the primary recording.

errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server. Try again later.
errors.setup_done: Setup is already done. Sign in instead.
errors.setup_token_invalid: The setup token is wrong or expired. Check the server log for the current one.
errors.invitation_invalid: This invitation is invalid, used or expired.
errors.invitation_not_found: This invitation is no longer open.
errors.email_taken: Someone with this e-mail address already has an account.
errors.reset_link_invalid: This link is invalid, used or expired.
errors.last_admin: This is the only admin. Make someone else admin first.
errors.not_yourself: You can’t do this to yourself. Ask another admin.
errors.dive_not_found: This dive doesn’t exist or isn’t yours.
errors.recording_not_found: This recording doesn’t exist or isn’t yours.
errors.dive_changed: This dive was changed meanwhile. Reload it and make your changes again.
errors.dive_values_inconsistent: The average depth can’t be deeper than the max depth.
errors.recording_not_on_dive: This recording doesn’t belong to the dive.
errors.last_recording: This is the dive’s only recording, so it can’t be split off.
errors.diver_not_found: This Diver doesn’t exist or isn’t yours.
errors.own_diver: Your own Diver can’t be deleted.
errors.diver_not_empty: This Diver still has dives or devices.
errors.device_not_found: This device doesn’t exist or isn’t yours.
errors.not_a_candidate: That dive isn’t one of the suggestions.

history.title: History
history.fileReplaced: Recorded data replaced by a newer file
history.recordingRemoved: Recording split off into its own dive

decisions.title: Needs your decision
decisions.intro_one: One recording doesn’t clearly belong to a dive.
decisions.intro_other: {{count}} recordings don’t clearly belong to a dive.

divers.title: Divers
divers.intro: The Divers whose logbooks you keep. Your own comes first.
divers.notEmpty: Only Divers without dives or devices can be deleted.
divers.devicesIntro: Dive computers and transmitters that recorded your dives. Imports from a device go to the Diver it belongs to.
divers.assignHint: When you give a device to another Diver, imports from then on go to that Diver. Dives already in a logbook stay where they are.
divers.noDevices: No devices yet. They appear with your first import.
divers.sameName: You already have a Diver called {{name}}. That works, but the two will be hard to tell apart.
